Department of Homeland Security.title: FEMA FY2024 DRF obligations by month
Department of Homeland Security.basis: FEMA's final FY2024 Disaster Relief Fund report publishes $39.066B of actual obligations by month as of September 30, before final closeout. The 12 monthly rows reconcile exactly at the source's $1M precision. Obligations are a separate operational measure, not additive children of Treasury's $33.275B Disaster Relief cash-outlay classification or the Combined Statement's $29.498B DRF-account net outlay.

Department of Homeland Security.title: FEMA FY2024 catastrophic DRF obligations by declaration and geography
Department of Homeland Security.basis: FEMA's September 30 report publishes a $33.234B catastrophic-disaster subtotal by disaster declaration and geography. The 112 nonzero rows shown here reconcile exactly at the source's $1M precision; zero-obligation source rows are omitted. This pre-closeout obligation view is operational detail and is not additive to Treasury cash outlays.
